script_text:
Stop! Aries, your ruling planet Mars is throwing a tantrum in your domestic zone.

Mars, your Fire-sign ruler, sits in Cancer in your 4th House of Home, forming a harsh square to your natal Sun in the 1st House. This pits your personal drive against family responsibilities, creating irritability at the doorstep. Venus in Virgo sextiles Jupiter in your 3rd House of Communication, softening words just enough to negotiate a truce.

Single Aries, attract love through a family gathering or household introduction tonight. If taken, leave office stress outside the bedroom—your partner needs your presence, not your problems.

Money flows through your 10th House of Career via a casual conversation, so speak up at work and document every agreement—even a forgotten invoice may resurface.

Avoid signing any lease or property contract or making impulsive real estate moves under this square.

Follow for tomorrow's reading.
